brief.concept: How to Research NFL Player Props: A Game-Week Workflow
brief.primary_question: How do you research NFL player props?
brief.audience: NFL fans and DFS or pick'em users who want a repeatable, source-aware research process
brief.learning_outcome: Verify the current market, evaluate role, injury, matchup, agents, and confidence, and recognize when no action is the correct outcome
brief.cta: Read the NFL research guide, then open the NFL analyzer when a verified slate is available
